text:
Assistant A is more accurate and directly responsive. It correctly identifies the main US and Chinese antitrust authorities and laws, and its case studies—Microsoft and Alibaba—are relevant and factually sound. Assistant B provides more detail, but its China case study on Didi Chuxing is problematic: the investigation and settlement details are inaccurate, and the NDRC is not the primary antitrust enforcer in the way described. B also overstates how many times China’s Anti-Monopoly Law has been amended. While B is more expansive, A’s comparison is clearer and more reliable.

[[A]]
